decisions.reason: The requested tortilla, steak-streak, and stamp-like text adjustments apply specifically to the stamped-meat design, not the completed bottle-and-cloud illustration.

Although both illustrations contain steak and text, the source concerns tortillas, streaks on the steak, and stamped text in the separate stamped-meat design; it does not change the grill illustration.
The source adjustments are confined to the stamped-meat illustration and do not alter the Riverton sky-text design.
The visual revisions do not change the requirement that the artwork be hand-drawn and non-AI.
The source changes illustration details only and does not modify the required green-background and non-green-background PNG variants.
